summary: Backend-only testing for Cak Mad Quiz API. Created pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_cakmad_api.py covering root, auth (session exchange invalid, /auth/me missing/invalid/malformed bearer), scores auth-protection, public leaderboard (classic, time_attack, default, limit), CORS (simple + preflight), and MongoDB indexes (users.email unique, users.user_id unique, user_sessions.session_token unique, best_scores composite). All 16 tests passed against public URL https://ballgame-id.preview.emergentagent.com.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: `logger` is defined AFTER the auth_session route uses `logger.exception` (line 111). Works at request time because logging.basicConfig and `logger` are set at import of the module BEFORE first request, but defining them before routes is cleaner.

auth/session exchange stores session_token returned by Emergent as-is; if the same Google user logs in multiple times you will accumulate rows in user_sessions. A TTL index on expires_at exists which cleans them up, OK.

best_scores is upserted but ScoreSubmit does not validate mode/category enum values. Consider Literal['classic','time_attack'] and Literal['all','guess','history','trivia'] to reject bad inputs with 422.
CORS: allow_credentials=True combined with allow_origins=['*'] – browsers ignore ACAO='*' with credentials. Starlette echoes origin so it works, but tightening to a known origin list is safer.
No rate limiting on /auth/session or /scores. Fine for MVP but note for prod.
seed_data_creation: None. Tests only hit public endpoints and read-only Mongo index metadata; no documents written.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public backend URL is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL in /app/frontend/.env (https://ballgame-id.preview.emergentagent.com). No valid Google session_id is available, so a successful /api/auth/session (and downstream /api/scores success + leaderboard write) cannot be validated end-to-end in this environment — only the 401 paths were verified. For a full flow test, the main agent would need to complete the Emergent Google OAuth redirect in the UI and capture the session_id from the fragment URL. Mongo URL/DB read from /app/backend/.env via dotenv in TestMongoIndexes.
